description:
TimescaleDB is a PostgreSQL extension for time-series data that deserves
first-class platform status in BenchBox. Currently it's only supported as
a flag on PostgreSQL (--postgres-enable-timescale).

A dedicated TimescaleDB adapter would:
- Appear as a separate platform in the interactive wizard
- Leverage hypertables for time-series optimized storage
- Use TimescaleDB-specific compression and retention policies
- Support TSBS (Time Series Benchmark Suite) in addition to TPC benchmarks
- Provide TimescaleDB-specific tuning profiles

This builds on the existing PostgreSQL adapter infrastructure.

**Code Review Findings (2024-12-24):**
The following TimescaleDB-related code already exists:
- `--postgres-enable-timescale` CLI flag (platforms/postgresql.py:116-119)
- `enable_timescale` config stored but NOT USED (platforms/postgresql.py:209)
- `get_platform_info()` detects TimescaleDB version (platforms/postgresql.py:676-686)
- `tsbs_devops/schema.py` has `timescale` dialect with hypertable creation
- `nyctaxi/schema.py` has `timescale` dialect handling

Key decision: Created separate TimescaleDBAdapter class extending PostgreSQLAdapter.
